candidates.title: Kevin Hart: I'm a Grown Little Man
candidates.description: Stand-up comedy star Kevin Hart delivers his unique perspective on work, race, family and friends with this laugh-riot comedy show.

candidates.title: Ray Romano: Right Here, Around the Corner
candidates.description: Ray Romano cut his stand-up teeth at the Comedy Cellar in New York. Now, in his first comedy special in 23 years, he returns to where it all began.

candidates.title: Chelsea Handler: Uganda Be Kidding Me Live
candidates.description: In her first Netflix stand-up comedy special, Chelsea Handler recounts her African adventures (and provides hilarious photographic evidence).

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Seriously Funny
candidates.description: With his unique hip-hop style delivery, African American stand-up comedian Kevin Hart expounds on life at a sold-out concert performance.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Don’t F**k This Up
candidates.description: Amid turmoil in his career and marriage, comedian and film star Kevin Hart opens up about his personal breakthroughs as he navigates crises and fame.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Laugh at My Pain
candidates.description: Sometimes edgy and always hilarious, comedian Kevin Hart shines in this theatrical version of his record-breaking 2011 live tour.

candidates.title: Eddie Murphy: Raw
candidates.description: This stand-up comedy classic features Eddie Murphy live in a provocative series of impressions, observations and remembrances of his childhood.

candidates.title: The Original Kings of Comedy
candidates.cast: Steve Harvey, D.L. Hughley, Cedric the Entertainer, Bernie Mac
candidates.description: Director Spike Lee documents the last night of the hit comedy tour featuring comics Steve Harvey, Cedric the Entertainer, D.L. Hughley and Bernie Mac.

candidates.title: Seth Rogen's Hilarity for Charity
candidates.cast: Seth Rogen, Ike Barinholtz, Michael Che, Sacha Baron Cohen, Jeff Goldblum, Tiffany Haddish, Chris Hardwick, Nick Kroll, John Mulaney, Kumail Nanjiani, Chelsea Peretti, Craig Robinson & The Nasty Delicious, Lauren Miller Rogen, Justin Roiland, Sarah Silverman, Michelle Wolf
candidates.description: Seth Rogen and friends combine stand-up, sketches and music for an outrageous comedy special that could only come from the mind of Seth.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Irresponsible
candidates.description: As a father of three on his second marriage, Kevin Hart proves that being him is indeed a tall order in a fresh special inspired by his own mistakes.

candidates.title: Mike Epps: Only One Mike
candidates.description: In a raw stand-up comedy special, Mike Epps mixes it up as he tackles sexual misconduct, special ed, aging body parts and much more.

candidates.title: Best of Stand-Up 2020
candidates.cast: Jerry Seinfeld, Leslie Jones, Taylor Tomlinson, Tom Segura, Jack Whitehall, Michelle Buteau, Bert Kreischer, Jo Koy, Donnell Rawlings, Jim Jefferies, Nikki Glaser, George Lopez, Sam Jay, Marc Maron, Kevin Hart, Michael McIntyre, Fortune Feimster, Eric André, Jim Norton, Felipe Esparza, Hannah Gadsby, Patton Oswalt, Vir Das, Robert Kelly, Urzila Carlson, Tom Papa, Kanan Gill, Ms. Pat, Rob Schneider, Adrienne Iapalucci, Kenny Sebastian, Thomas Middleditch, Ben Schwartz
candidates.description: From Jerry Seinfeld to Leslie Jones, Kevin Hart to Hannah Gadsby, laugh along with the funniest bits from Netflix's 2020 stand-up comedy specials.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
candidates.description: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

candidates.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
candidates.description: Levelheaded stand-up Tom Segura shares offhand appraisals on hotels and opens up about his hobbies and digestive ailments in this comedy special.

candidates.title: Garfunkel and Oates: Trying to be Special
candidates.cast: Riki Lindhome, Kate Micucci, Anthony Jeselnik, Steve Agee
candidates.description: Garfunkel and Oates put on a surprise-filled show in Seattle in hopes of raising enough money to make their own comedy special.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: What Now?
candidates.cast: Kevin Hart, Don Cheadle, Halle Berry, Ed Helms, David Meunier
candidates.description: Frenetic comic Kevin Hart hits Philadelphia and dishes on suburban wildlife, jean shorts and the fine art of getting even with a 7-year-old.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart's Guide to Black History
candidates.cast: Kevin Hart, Saniyya Sidney, Lil Rel Howery, Eoghan Thomas Murphy, Tiffany Haddish, Al Shearer, Lonnie Chavis, Alphonso Mcauley, Nika Williams, Barry Brewer, Greg Germann, John Ennis, Jay Johnston
candidates.description: Kevin Hart highlights the fascinating contributions of black history’s unsung heroes in this entertaining – and educational – comedy special.

candidates.title: The Comedy Lineup
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.cast: Michelle Buteau, Ian Karmel, Taylor Tomlinson, Sam Jay, Phil Wang, Sabrina Jalees, Jak Knight, Tim Dillon
candidates.description: A diverse group of up-and-coming comedians perform 15-minute sets in this stand-up comedy showcase series.

candidates.title: Kevin James: Never Don't Give Up
candidates.description: Kevin James makes his long-awaited return to stand-up in this family-friendly special, dishing on fatherhood, fans, his disdain for allergies and more.

candidates.title: Kevin Hart: Let Me Explain
candidates.description: Philadelphia funnyman Kevin Hart takes the stage in front of a sold-out crowd at Madison Square Garden, part of his hit "Let Me Explain" world tour.

candidates.title: Hari Kondabolu: Warn Your Relatives
candidates.description: Hari Kondabolu breaks down identity politics, celebrity encounters, his mango obsession and more in an unpredictable stand-up comedy special.
